Registered Physiotherapist – Join the Movement at Mobility Room
Location: Whitby, ON
Position: Part-Time / Full-Time / Hybrid Options | Passive Income Potential

Our Mission: More Than Rehab. It’s a Movement.

Mobility Room is a rapidly growing rehabilitation clinic built around a collaborative Physiotherapist-led model.

We believe patients deserve more than temporary relief. Our goal is to identify the root cause of dysfunction, create a clear treatment plan, and guide patients toward long-term results through a combination of hands-on care, mobility restoration, exercise rehabilitation, and movement-focused treatment.

Our Physiotherapists work alongside Kinesiologists, Athletic Therapists, Osteopaths and other Rehabilitation Practitioners in a team-based environment that allows them to focus on assessment, clinical decision-making, treatment planning, reassessment, and patient outcomes while maintaining oversight of patient progression.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Physiotherapist who wants more than simply treating patients back-to-back all day. We're looking for someone who is passionate about helping people move better, mentoring others, and growing within a collaborative team.

What You'll Do

Assessment & Clinical Leadership

Perform comprehensive Physiotherapy assessments and reassessments
Develop individualized treatment plans based on patient goals and clinical findings
Identify movement dysfunctions and contributing factors affecting recovery
Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans as needed

Hands-On Treatment

Deliver evidence-informed physiotherapy treatment
Utilize manual therapy, soft tissue techniques, mobility restoration, exercise prescription, and movement retraining
Educate patients on recovery expectations and long-term self-management strategies

Collaborative Care

Work closely with our Rehabilitation Practitioners
Delegate appropriate aspects of patient care while maintaining clinical oversight
Participate in case discussions and collaborative treatment planning
Support continuity of care throughout the patient journey

Growth & Development

Participate in internal education sessions and mentorship opportunities
Contribute to clinic growth initiatives, workshops, community events, or content creation
Help shape the future of Mobility Room as we expand.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you:

Are registered and in good standing with the College of Physiotherapists of Ontario
Believe rehabilitation should focus on long-term outcomes, not just symptom relief
Enjoy combining hands-on treatment with exercise-based rehabilitation
Are comfortable collaborating with other healthcare professionals
Value patient education and creating meaningful relationships
Are growth-minded, coachable, and committed to continuous learning
Want to be part of a positive, team-oriented culture

New graduates are welcome to apply.

What We Offer

Competitive Compensation

Clear compensation structure with opportunities for advancement and leadership growth.

Full Administrative Support

Our team handles scheduling, billing, direct billing, patient communication, recalls, and follow-up systems so you can focus on patient care.

Consistent Caseload Growth

Established referral relationships, community partnerships, digital marketing, and internal systems designed to support clinician growth.

Clinical Mentorship

Regular one-on-one mentorship, team learning sessions, and support from experienced clinicians.

Continuing Education Support

We actively invest in clinician development and provide opportunities to expand your clinical skill set.

Potential training pathways may include:

Fascial Stretch Therapy (FST)
Anatomy in Motion (AiM)
NeuroKinetic Therapy (NKT)
Functional Range Conditioning
Dry Needling
Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy
Leadership and mentorship development

Modern Clinic Environment

Fully equipped rehabilitation space
Private treatment rooms
Collaborative multidisciplinary team
Supportive and growth-focused culture

Career Advancement Opportunities

Mobility Room has a structured growth pathway for Physiotherapists

Additional opportunities may include:

Lead Physiotherapist
Clinical Mentor
Clinic Leadership Roles
Future expansion opportunities

Why Mobility Room?

We're building a clinic where clinicians can grow professionally while helping patients achieve lasting results.

We value:

Clinical excellence
Collaboration
Education
Innovation
Accountability
Patient experience

If you're looking for a clinic where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work makes a meaningful impact, we'd love to hear from you.
